# Institute of NeuroDevelopment

> A parent-led neurodevelopment system founded by Dr. Diptanshu Das, helping families of children with autism, ADHD, speech delay and related challenges create measurable developmental progress at home.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What the parent-led neurodevelopment system is and who it is for.
- [About](/about): Dr. Diptanshu Das and the founding principles of IND.
- [Approach](/approach): The 4-Phase Sequential Flightpath and drivers-not-labels model.
- [Services](/services): Areas we help families with.
- [Programs](/programs): Masterclass, pre-enrollment and Flightpath programs.
- [Science of Stuck Masterclass](/science-of-stuck): 3-hour live masterclass for parents.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers on slow progress, fragmented advice and therapy dependency.
- [Quiz](/quiz): A 60-second qualifier quiz recommending the right next step.
- [Contact](/contact): Book an appointment, online or in Kolkata.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles and online job application with resume upload.
